samples.question: The picture shows one lattice of 13 rows and 33 columns of square cells, with a blue square printed at each of its four corners. Every cell is either white (open) or dark (blocked). Three rooms are outlined in green; each room is 9 rows tall and 9 columns wide, and each room is walled in except for the single cell in its bottom wall that may be open. A red dot is printed in one open cell: that is where you start. Now walk: from the cell you are in you may step to the cell directly above, below, to the left or to the right, but only onto white cells, never onto a dark cell and never diagonally. Shade every cell you can reach from the red dot by repeating such steps. Exactly one room contains shaded cells. Inside that room the shaded cells form a shape that most closely matches one of these five symbols: comb, cross, cup, ell, tee. Ignore the shaded corridor cells outside the rooms, and ignore the white cells of rooms you cannot reach. Which symbol is it? Answer with one word.
